classification_thresholds.note: auto_disable_threshold=0.0 means only tools with zero calls AND zero errors are auto-disable candidates; all are still subject to the safety rule requiring human confirmation

safety_rules.note: Tools with error_rate=0.0 AND calls_30d=0 may be emergency-only. Never auto-disable without human confirmation.

cost_model.note: standing_context_per_token_cost represents the cost of including one token in every session's context. At $3/M input tokens for Haiku, a tool description loaded in every session costs this per token per session.

telemetry.note: calls_per_session for scoring is normalised by dividing by the single highest calls_30d value across all tools, producing a value in [0,1]
